args.name: Practical root cooking
args.function: Prepare an owned meadow root into a cooked meal through a physically feasible process, with observable results and explicit material, heat and energy requirements.
args.conditions: I have six recently gathered meadow roots after eating the older root. Raw roots are known food with nutrition 14 and toxicity zero. Nearby fallen branches are visible, but I have no established cooking equipment or known heat source. My cultivation plot has established but has produced no visible food.
args.inputs: Owned meadow roots; other necessary materials or equipment must be identified and actually obtained. No fuel, tools or heat should be assumed.
args.costs: Method, learning time, preparation time, energy, fuel and equipment requirements are unknown; specify a minimal feasible process and its safety conditions.
args.effects: Allow an actual preparation trial and inspection of its resulting food, consumption of real inputs, and any evidenced changes in nutrition, perishability or meal qualities. No guaranteed improvement or happiness award.

candidates.function: Plant one owned food unit from a living plant in a small hand-dug plot, where it may root as a new plant under the existing plant rules; inspect units, sites, plants and plot progress; tend plots; abandon unfinished planting.
candidates.costs: Study: 3 rounds. Plant: inputStackId names one whole owned, untreated, unspoiled food unit (quantity 1; one plot per unit) gathered from a living plant; x, y a 0.25 m plot within reach on ordinary meadow soil (.), waterlogging at most 0.1, soil moisture 0.3-1.2, 0.6 m clear of objects and people, with fewer than 3 plants of that food within 5 m. Two paid rounds of 1 energy: dig, then place and cover the unit; plant resumes paused work after rechecking reach, site, unit and energy. Inspect and inspect-progress: one round, 0.2 energy. Inspect: inputStackId checks a unit (with x, y also a site for it), or target a plant source or plot in reach. Inspect-progress: target a plot in reach. Tend: target a planted plot in reach; one round, 0.5 energy. Abandon: stops unfinished planting; one round, no energy. Harvest uses gather. No tool, water or seed is given.
candidates.effects: Digging keeps the unit carried, owned and ageing. Placing moves it, with origin and age, into the plot, where it cannot be eaten or used; the plot becomes a propagule exactly like a naturally dispersed one. It establishes only through actual temperature, light, soil moisture and season; cold, darkness or drought stall it; if the buried unit spoils first, the plot dies. On rooting, the unit becomes a new plant with no stock (ceiling 4), regrowing under the natural rule, harvested by anyone with gather; a ledger records growth and units produced and removed. Nothing is copied or guaranteed. A unit check reports decay, treatment, origin and whether it can be planted, never viability. Inspect-progress reports visible changes since your last look, else inconclusive; trial window 20 rounds, optional checks at 5, 10 and 20; not a growth date. Tend checks the plot and its 0.6 m clearance, kept free of plants by the plant rules; it removes nothing and adds no water, nutrient or growth. Records are unverified. An unworked round pauses; low energy, leaving reach or a changed site pause without charge; a lost or spoiled unit stops the work. Abandon, or death, before placement returns the unit once (where the person died); a placed unit stays. No reward or refund.

candidates.costs: A game round to begin study after review; implementation time does not advance simulation.

candidates.function: Invite listeners to meet at a place and a later round within 200 rounds, with an optional note of up to 120 characters.
candidates.costs: One round; no energy or material.
candidates.effects: Heard like tell, and leaves an invitation sign where you stand until 10 rounds after the meeting. At that round an attendance event records who is within 2.5 units of the place. No physical effect.

candidates.function: Collect exposed ripe food or loose material from a nearby natural source.
candidates.costs: 2 energy per unit, finite current source stock.
candidates.effects: Transfers real source stock to inventory; requires the source interaction range. No processing or felling is implied.

candidates.function: Leave a mark or inscription of up to 120 characters on the ground here (empty subject) or on an object or item within reach.
candidates.costs: One round; no energy or material.
candidates.effects: Leaves a persistent mark sign where you stand that nearby people can see; your 24 most recent names and marks persist. No physical effect.

candidates.function: Say up to 240 characters aloud; everyone living within 5 units hears it, seen or not.
candidates.costs: One round; no energy or material.
candidates.effects: Each listener receives a heard event and keeps it in a short heard list. Nothing persists at the place. No physical effect.

candidates.function: Transfer a nearby ground stack into personal inventory.
candidates.effects: Requires actual distance within pickup reach; resource:ID means a matching nearby visible ground stack.

packet.access: Search or retrieve only this experiment abilities with control queries. Missing candidates do not prove a function absent. Full implementation facts remain available in the development handoff; never grant inventory or individual mastery. Require actual physical prerequisites.
